name: B-1B Lancer
note: Model replacement: B-1B Lancer.mtb on the existing B-1B data. Originals kept in tools/vehgen/replaced/b_1b. Extended wings (20/22) go into the sweep bones; the swept copies (21/23) are dropped. The fin's aft strip is the rudder; the all-moving tailplanes go into elevator_8/9. No baked stores (internal bays).
note_sweep: The template rig swept about [0,0,1] (wings drooping). The model's swept pose (21) is its extended pose (20) turned 42 degrees about the wing root leading edge (76.42, -11.13), fit residual 0. Range 52 degrees (real 15-67.5).
note_crew: New flight deck: seat backs at z -242 (headrests to y 85-88, x 6.2-14), cushions y ~67, panel top y 81 at z -262..-255, windscreen frame y ~93. The template eyes sat inside the seat backs (z -237) and the copilot's 4.5 px lower; both now 4 px in front of the headrest at y 83 (2 px over the panel), seats keep the template's eye-to-seat offset (14.4 px). The rear stations (crew 3/4) are windowless as on the real aircraft and keep their template eyes.
